title: Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act
full_text:
ADDENDUM <Act No. 16096, Dec. 31, 2018>
Article 1 (Enforcement date)
This Act shall enter into force on January 1, 2019.
Article 2 (Amendment of other Acts)
(1) The Act to Repeal the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act (Act No. 9346) (including the provisions amended respectively by the Act Partially Amending the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act (Act No. 9901), the Act Partially Amending the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act (Act No. 11603) and the Act Partially Amending the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act (Act No. 13550)) is partially amended as follows:
In Article 1 of the Addenda, "January 1, 2019" is replaced by "January 1, 2022".
In Article 3 (3) of the Addenda, "Article 21 (1) 8" is replaced by "Article 21 (2) 5"; "'individual consumption tax, liquor tax or traffic tax'" is replaced by "'individual consumption tax, liquor tax and traffic, energy and environment tax'"; and "'individual consumption tax or liquor tax'" is replaced by "'individual consumption tax and liquor tax'".
(2) The Act Partially Amending the Act on Temporary Special Cases concerning the Customs Act and Other Acts pursuant to the Implementation of the Agreement under Article IV of the Mutual Defense Treaty between the Republic of Korea and the United States of America regarding Facilities and Areas and the Status of United States Armed Forces in the Republic of Korea (Act No. 9902) (including the provisions amended respectively by the Act Partially Amending the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act (Act No. 11603) and the Act Partially Amending the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act (Act No. 13550)) is partially amended as follows:
In the proviso to the Addenda, "January 1, 2019" is replaced by "January 1, 2022".
(3) The Act Partially Amending the Corporate Tax Act (Act No. 10423) (including the provisions amended respectively by the Act Partially Amending the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act (Act No. 11603) and the Act Partially Amending the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act (Act No. 13550)) is partially amended as follows:
In the proviso to Article 1 of the Addenda, "January 1, 2019" is replaced by "January 1, 2022".
(4) The Act Wholly Amending the Framework Act on Environmental Policy (Act No. 10893) (including the provisions amended respectively by the Act Partially Amending the Framework Act on Environmental Policy (Act No. 11268), the Act Partially Amending the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act (Act No. 11603) and the Act Partially Amending the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act (Act No. 13550)) is partially amended as follows:
In the portion of Article 4-2 of the Addenda other than its subparagraphs, "December 31, 2018" is replaced by "December 31, 2021".
